category: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control (PR.AC-P)
subcategory_text: Access permissions and authorizations are managed, incorporating the principles of least privilege and separation of duties.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: AC-6 (Least Privilege), AC-5 (Separation of Duties)
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.5.15 (Access control), A.8.3 (Information access restriction)
implementation_examples: Manage access permissions and authorisations using least privilege and separation of duties, with periodic reviews and just-in-time elevation
Capture role and policy in a central IAM system
assessment_objectives: Determine whether access permissions are managed per least privilege
Determine whether separation of duties is enforced where applicable
Determine whether reviews are periodic and evidenced
Determine whether entitlement anomalies are detected and investigated
